storyCards.headline: Free Fallin': A Cultural Moment Captured on Record
storyCards.fact:
John Mayer's "Free Fallin'" reached #51 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #51 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 10 weeks on the chart.

Free Fallin' was released in 2008.

Album: Where The Light Is: John Mayer Live In Los Angeles (2008).
